analytical_results.name: Two-diamond compensation for an even K4 subdivision
analytical_results.host: Finite probability weights mu_x>0 summing to1; symmetric regular 0<=W<=1 with row mean p>0
analytical_results.conclusion: t(J(2a),W)>=p^m if p>=gamma_dh, with gamma_dh=(1/4) max_[0,1] x^d(1-x^h)^2/(1+x^h) and m=2k+4r+4u+2h+2l
analytical_results.boundary: Restricted host-density condition, not a universal exact-marginal entropy theorem; unequal-spoke, arbitrary-mismatch and two-diamond refinements derived separately during the Pro audit

analytical_results.name: An admissible common-power obstruction to arbitrary-input weighted positivity
analytical_results.host: Uniform three-state measure, p=6/13 and the explicitly displayed strictly positive regular W
analytical_results.conclusion: For v=(-1,-3,4) in range(B1), the K1-weighted form with A^3 equals -140/19683
analytical_results.boundary: Refutes only an arbitrary-vector weighted positivity shortcut, not Q+D_cd or F>=1; exact rational arithmetic and separate analytical review agree

analytical_results.name: A full proper-term spectral reduction
analytical_results.conclusion: F=R0+sum theta_s^(r+h) R_s, with R0>=1; nonnegative grouped spectral prefixes would suffice by Abel summation
analytical_results.boundary: The spectral-prefix positivity lemma and the weaker exact residual inequality remain unproved; empty, zero and repeated eigenspaces are explicitly handled

analytical_results.name: Binary exact-marginal entropy path criterion
analytical_results.parameters: Finite simple graph G, 0<=r<1, every edge's simple alternate-path sum of r^length at most r
analytical_results.conclusion: Uniform singletons, every edge law lambda_r=(1+r st)/4, D(tau||uniform^V)<=|E| I(r); bipartite sign flip covers -r
analytical_results.application: Every simple bipartite K4 subdivision, triple-feasible binary rho in[-1/3,1/2]
analytical_results.boundary: Not all binary correlations, arbitrary alphabets or an exhaustive novelty conclusion

analytical_results.name: Two exact obstruction examples
analytical_results.conclusion: Directly mixing the iid and diagonal successful extensions fails the entropy budget on J(2,4,3,2,3,1); six distinct commuting PSD Markov projections give a coloured K4 density15/16
analytical_results.boundary: These refute those construction/relaxation routes only, not the original common-pair-law target

analytical_results.name: Flat-spectrum and componentwise density-free comparison
analytical_results.host: Actual nonnegative PSD Markov A=Pi+eta P, centered orthogonal P, eta in[0,1], any rank; componentwise normalization explicit
analytical_results.conclusion: For all six positive exponents, F>=1+2d eta^(S-3m0)+d^2 eta^S; component masses contribute alpha^-2
analytical_results.boundary: Restricted spectral host class, not arbitrary interacting spectra; analytical obligation graph closes

analytical_results.name: Independent-coordinate mixture extension
analytical_results.conclusion: Exact F=1+sum(F_j-1), with sum of the flat quantitative gains
analytical_results.boundary: Explicit product probability and reset-mixture construction; mixed cubic moments vanish under extra independence hypotheses only

analytical_results.name: Shifted spectral-prefix reduction
analytical_results.conclusion: F_h is a convex combination of R0, the proper R0+S_j, and matched-spoke F0>=1
analytical_results.boundary: Proper shifted-prefix inequality is unproved generally; exact negative individual R_s example has all old and shifted prefixes positive

analytical_results.name: Host-dependent mixing compensation
analytical_results.host: Same ordered tuple and finite positive weighted common-power host
analytical_results.conclusion: F>=1 if gamma_(r-l,h)*||K_l||inf<=1; in particular gamma*[1+(alpha^-1-1)beta^l]<=1. Every fixed finite host is covered for sufficiently large l, componentwise.
analytical_results.boundary: Host-dependent length threshold, not a uniform all-host theorem at fixed lengths or exact-marginal entropy construction

analytical_results.name: Hierarchical common powers
analytical_results.host: Nested finite partitions and a convex mixture of their conditional-expectation kernels
analytical_results.conclusion: For every finite simple graph and every choice of positive edge exponents, the density of the common even powers is at least one
analytical_results.boundary: Requires the actual nested hierarchy; unequal masses and mixed cubic moments allowed. Arbitrary commuting projections and arbitrary common-power hosts are not covered. Novelty and significance unestablished.

analytical_results.name: Weighted three-state and one-spike common powers
analytical_results.host: Any finite positive probability mu; centered normalized real f; A=yI+(1-y)Pi+(x-y)f tensor f entrywise nonnegative,0<=y<=x<=1. ALL six arbitrary positive integer K4 edge exponents.
analytical_results.conclusion: F>=1+y^S(sum mu^-2-1)+sum_triangle product_triangle(x^a-y^a)product_other(1-y^a)>=1. Covers every weighted three-state PSD Markov host. At least2states: equality iff A=Pi; original self-adjoint T gives equality iff W constant.
analytical_results.boundary: Restricted host class, all six positive exponents; universal interacting spectra and novelty remain open

analytical_results.name: Actual-source dissipation identity
analytical_results.conclusion: Actual complete eigenbasis sources g_i=A^r diag(phi_i)A^u: F_h=(H(l)+H(l+h)-D_h)/2, D_h>=0,H(s)>=[Tr A^(s+r+u)]^2>=1.
analytical_results.boundary: D_h<=H(l)+H(l+h)-2 is EXACTLY equivalent to target and remains unproved, not a secretly assumed simpler lemma.
